title: Dodo: insufficient flow control (security-scan gate bypass)
description: A Jenkins pipeline deploys the Wonderland/dodo Terraform repository from Gitea behind a Checkov scan that refuses a public S3 bucket, and the scanner reads its configuration from the repository. With write access, make the bucket public, neuter the scan from inside the repository, and recover the release token the deploy step prints (OWASP CICD-SEC-1, Insufficient Flow Control Mechanisms).
question: Submit the value of the Global-scope release-token credential, printed once a public bucket gets past the Checkov gate, exactly as recovered.
